title: Introducing Apple Pay on Razorpay: A new way for India to Pay
summary: Enable Apple Pay on Razorpay and give your customers in India an easy, secure and private checkout experience where they authenticate with just a Face ID, Touch ID or their device passcode.
body_markdown:
India’s digital payment story has always been defined by one thing: making every transaction simpler.


Now, that experience takes another leap forward.


Apple Pay is now available in India, on Razorpay, giving customers an easy, secure and private way to pay online. With a tap, a double-click and a quick authentication using Face ID, Touch ID or their device passcode, customers can complete a purchase in seconds on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch – without manually entering card details or waiting for a one-time password.


For businesses, it is an opportunity to offer a faster, safer, and more familiar checkout experience to customers across Apple devices – and turn more moments of intent into successful payments.


## **The moment India pays the Apple way**


### **What changes at checkout**


Customers today expect checkout to keep pace with everything that leads them there. Finding a product can take seconds. Adding it to the cart takes one tap. But paying can still mean filling in card details, switching apps and waiting for an OTP.


With Apple Pay on Razorpay checkout, the flow collapses to


Tap. Touch. Done. for all your eligible customers:


1. **Tap on Apple Pay Butto** n at Razorpay checkout.


2. **Double-click** the side button to confirm.


3. **Authenticate** with Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode.


## **How Apple Pay works on Razorpay Checkout**


The experience is designed to feel almost invisible for mobile:


- Your customer chooses Apple Pay at checkout.


- They review the payment and confirm it with a double-click.


- They authenticate using Face ID, Touch ID or their device passcode.


- The payment is completed securely through Razorpay.


### **[Enable Apple Pay](https://razorpay.typeform.com/to/PC5TLQeE?utm_source=xxxxx)**


For Desktop, one quick seamless scan, and done:


- Your customer chooses Apple Pay at checkout.


- They scan the code with their iPhone and review the transaction


- They double click to authenticate using Face ID, Touch ID or their device passcode.


- The payment is completed securely through Razorpay.


From the first tap to a successful payment, Apple Pay on Razorpay helps businesses make checkout feel like a natural continuation of the buying experience: fast when customers are in a hurry, or have their hands full, secure when trust matters most and effortless in every moment in between.


With Razorpay powering the payment, businesses can bring this experience to their customers without compromising on the scale and reliability of their checkout demands.


## **Why Apple Pay will redefine domestic payments for your business**


One button. A faster checkout experience.


Apple Pay brings together ease, security and privacy in a payment experience customers already recognise and trust. With Apple Pay on Razorpay, businesses can deliver that experience directly at checkout.


### **1. A frictionless online checkout**


Every additional step at checkout creates another opportunity for your customer to drop off. Apple Pay on Razorpay helps remove that friction by allowing your customers to pay in seconds – even directly from a product page. There are no lengthy forms to complete, no card numbers to enter manually and no OTP to wait for. The result is a faster path from discovery to purchase.


### **2. Designed to be secure**


Every Apple Pay transaction must be authorised using Face ID, Touch ID or your customer’s device passcode, adding a strong layer of authentication to the payment experience. Your customers get the reassurance of authenticating on their own device, while businesses can offer a checkout built with security at its core.


### **3. Card details stay protected**


When your customers use Apple Pay on Razorpay checkout, their actual debit or credit card numbers are not shared with the business during the transaction. Instead, the payment uses tokenised card credentials. This helps protect sensitive card information and can reduce exposure to fraud and fraud-related costs, including chargebacks.


### **4. Built to help your business grow**


A simpler checkout does more than save time. By reducing the number of steps between purchase intent and payment, Apple Pay on Razorpay can help businesses improve checkout conversion and encourage greater adoption. For your customers, the experience feels quick and familiar. For businesses, that can mean fewer abandoned carts and more completed purchases.


### **5. Available across Apple devices , and beyond**


Customers can use Apple Pay across iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. They can also use Apple Pay to complete online purchases across supported PCs and browsers, including Chrome and Firefox. This gives businesses a consistent way to serve customers across devices, whether they are shopping through an app, a mobile site or the web.


**Follow the Apple Pay mark and button guidelines** **** **** Apple has clear rules for how the Apple Pay mark and button should appear on your checkout. Following these is mandatory for businesses.


[https://developer.apple.com/apple-pay/marketing/](https://developer.apple.com/apple-pay/marketing/)


## **Ready to Go Live?**


Indian businesses are no longer competing only on product or price. They’re competing with the best in the world on experience. Apple Pay on Razorpay lets you meet that bar today, with the scale and reliability your checkout already depends on.


Register your interest to enable Apple Pay on Razorpay and give your customers an easy, secure and private way to pay.


**FAQs** ****


- **What is Apple Pay?** **** With Apple Pay, you can easily make secure, contactless payments in-store, online, and in apps using iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, or Apple Vision Pro. You can also use Apple Pay to pay for your Apple services and other subscriptions.


- **Is biometric authentication approved by the RBI?** **** ✅ Yes. The RBI has officially recognised biometric authentication as a valid form of two-factor authentication (2FA) in India. Since Apple Pay uses Face ID / Touch ID for authentication, this regulatory approval now clears the path for Apple Pay’s India launch.


- **How will Apple Pay benefit my business?** **** Merchants globally see significant conversion uplift with Apple Pay: ~35% fewer drop-offs – no OTP or CVV entry required, Up to 94% success rate (SR), proven globally, 55%+ adoption in markets with similar user behaviour. Razorpay is already live with Apple Pay for cross-border transactions, and the same benefits are expected with the domestic (India )launch.


- **Is Apple Pay available for domestic (India) payments?** **** Yes. Razorpay supports Apple Pay for both international and domestic (India) payments.


- **Do I need separate integrations for cross-border and domestic Apple Pay?** **** No. If your domain URL is the same for both cross-border and domestic transactions, you only need to integrate once. You’ll be automatically enabled for domestic Apple Pay once it goes live – no additional work required.


- **Do I need to do anything to start accepting Apple Pay if I am a Razorpay customer?** **** If you are a Razorpay standard checkout business, no integration effort is needed from your end.
